question:
A collection of geometric figures is said to satisfy Helly property if the following condition holds: for any choice of three figures $A,B,C$ from the collection satisfying $A\cap B
e\varnothing$, $B\cap C
e\varnothing$ and $C\cap A
e\varnothing$, one must have $A\cap B\cap C
e\varnothing$. Which of the following collections satisfy Helly property?

options.C: A set of squares with sides parallel to the axes
options.D: A set of horizontal line segments
